name: goal-meta
description: Evaluations for goal-meta trigger boundaries and output contract

evals.name: trigger-positive
evals.description: Should trigger when the user explicitly asks for a Codex /goal or bounded agent goal

prompts.input: goal-meta 帮我把这个需求写成 Codex /goal：我要做一个 iOS 提词器 MVP
prompts.reason: Explicit skill name and Codex /goal request

prompts.input: 帮我把这个模糊任务转成 /goal，包含验证、边界和暂停条件
写一个 Goal 指令，让 agent 修这个 bug，但不能乱动生产配置
prompts.reason: Chinese Goal instruction request with boundaries

prompts.input: 这个是医疗相关工具，先帮我写 discovery-first 的 agent goal
我要开发一个网页游戏，给我推荐执行版中文 goal 和英文兼容版
prompts.reason: Requests the bilingual goal output shape

prompts.input: 为这个发布任务写一个不能直接推主分支的 /goal

evals.name: trigger-negative
evals.description: Should not trigger for adjacent planning, product, design, or direct execution requests

prompts.input: 帮我写一份 PRD，描述会员权益和用户故事
prompts.reason: PRD writing belongs to product skills

prompts.input: technical-design 给登录态刷新机制写一份技术方案
直接帮我实现这个 bug 修复
prompts.reason: The user wants execution, not a goal draft

prompts.input: review this code for security issues
prompts.reason: Code review should use review/security skills

prompts.input: 给我列一个 Q3 产品路线图
prompts.reason: Product roadmap planning belongs to roadmap-planner

prompts.input: 帮我定义这个功能的验收标准
prompts.reason: Ordinary acceptance criteria without a /goal request should not trigger
Simple translation does not need a durable agent goal

evals.name: output-contract
evals.description: Generated goals should include the required Chinese contract fields and English mirror
evals.prompt: goal-meta 把“做一个本地网页游戏 MVP”写成可直接复制的 /goal

checks.name: contains-goal-prefix
checks.description: Output starts from an executable /goal command

checks.name: contains-english-mirror
checks.description: Output includes the English-compatible mirror for Chinese users
